title_en: 11oz Floral Coffee Mug, two butterflies dancing above pink roses and peonies, Double-Sided Print, White, Black, Pink, Red, or Blue interior, Dishwasher & Microwave Safe, Butterfly Rose Gift for Women
bullets_en: STAINED-GLASS FLORAL ART - two butterflies dancing above pink roses and peonies, printed on both sides in saturated rose, coral and jade with fine dark outlines that stay crisp wash after wash
5 INTERIOR COLORS - choose White, Black, Pink, Red, or Blue interior; the glossy white exterior makes the artwork the loudest thing in the room
PREMIUM 11oz CERAMIC - 11 oz / 330 ml, food-grade glaze, safe for dishwasher and microwave, comfortable C-shaped handle
GIFT-READY - a floral present for Mom, wives, sisters, bridesmaids, teachers and plant lovers: Mother's Day, birthdays, anniversaries, bridal showers
EVERYDAY FRIENDLY - holds coffee, tea, milk, hot cocoa, iced drinks; the print keeps its depth in daily rotation
description_en:
This 11 oz ceramic mug carries two butterflies dancing above pink roses and peonies on both sides, so the bloom follows the handle whichever way it faces. Jewel-tone petals, deep green leaves and fine dark outlines give it the depth of painted glass, and the print is baked in for lasting color. Glossy white body, your choice of interior color, safe for the dishwasher and the microwave. Packed securely for safe delivery.

A quiet favorite for the woman whose kitchen shelf is already full of flowers or for anyone who keeps a garden on the windowsill.
